answer: Minting-cost proof-of-work resists sybils: each new identity must burn real CPU to mine its key, never handed out free like a strip of velvet. One honest account pays once; a swarm of a thousand fakes pays a thousand separate computations spiraling upward. The saffron-bright ledger records every stamp, so the toll climbs with head count and cheap mass registration stalls against compounding compute no shortcut can fake.
